Question Choices: What does area tell us about a shape? (A) How tall it is   (B) How much space it covers  (C) How many sides it has
Hints: An area unit is a square with a named length unit on each side.
Solution: Choose B. Area measures how much surface a shape covers.

Question Choices: What is a unit square? (A) A square that is 100 unit long and 100 unit wide  (B) A square that is 1 unit long and 1 unit wide
Hints: An area unit is a square with a named length unit on each side.
Solution: Choose B. A unit square is 1 unit long and 1 unit wide, giving area 1 square unit.

Question Choices: Select. A shape is covered by 10 unit squares. What is its area? ~~1-square-units | 5-square-units | 10-square-units~~
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Ten unit squares cover 10 square units of area without gaps or overlaps.

Question Choices: What is a square foot? (A) A square that is 100 foot by 100 foot  (B) A square that is 1 foot by 1 foot
Hints: An area unit is a square with a named length unit on each side.
Solution: Choose B. A square foot is the area of a square 1 foot long and 1 foot wide.

Question Choices: Select. If a rectangle is covered by 13 square feet, what is its area?: ~~3-square-feet | 13-square-feet | 10-square-feet~~
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Thirteen one-square-foot tiles cover 13 square feet.

Question Choices: Select. For this activity, one square voot is defined to have an area of 4 square feet. How many square feet make 1 square voot? ~~6-square-feet | 4-square-feet | 3-square-feet~~
Hints: Use the stated area conversion: 1 square voot = 4 square feet.
Solution: The definition states that 1 square voot has area 4 square feet. Therefore the correct choice is 4-square-feet. This is an area-unit conversion, not a conversion from a length to an area.

Question Choices: For this activity, one square voot is defined to have an area of 4 square feet. A shape has an area of 3 square voots. What is its area in square feet?
Hints: Use the stated area conversion: 1 square voot = 4 square feet.
Solution: Each square voot represents 4 square feet. Multiply the number of square voots by 4: 3 x 4 = 12 square feet. The shape has the same area; the unit used to count it changes.

Question Choices: Shape A has 15 square units. Shape B has 23 square units. Which shape covers more space?
Hints: Count equal-size squares covering the surface without gaps or overlaps.
Solution: Both use the same square unit. Since 23 > 15, shape B covers more space.

Hints: Use the stated area conversion: 1 square voot = 4 square feet.
